answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by analysing its interaction graph like a prism splitting light: honest agents form dense, overlapping clusters of repeated dealings, while fake identities usually connect to the honest region through only a few thin bridges. Like tracing a comet, auditors follow those sparse links and quarantine clusters that lack rich mutual history. The cost to an attacker is steep: each fake identity must fake months of genuine, reciprocal work, not just a velvet-smooth profile, before it is trusted.
